bead.title: Specify hot projection query contract
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The Snorri hot projection requirement has no governing contract document; `spec-id=api-hot-projection-query-surface` currently only exists on the tracker bead. Implementation beads need a stable, domain-neutral contract before adding API or backend code.

PROPOSED FIX
Create a contract doc under docs/ that defines the hot projection query substrate: capability names, typed indexed record shape, side/projection record semantics, consistency/watermark rules, cursor invalidation, aggregate limits, range scan/grouping/bounded mutation/claim-by-query operations, backend capability behavior, and non-goals. Include the six scheduled-action fixture records from pqueue-630dbeaa as an example fixture, but state that pqueue remains domain-neutral and Snorri-specific policy lives outside pqueue.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- docs/helix/02-design/contracts/ or docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/ for the new contract doc.
- docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/ if a test-plan pointer is needed.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Rust API implementation.
- Backend query implementation.
- Snorri/Cayce/MCP API design.

REQUIRED DECISIONS (the contract must settle these explicitly)
1. Null/missing indexed fields: today a record with a null or missing indexed field is simply absent from that index (projection `index_key` returns `None` — see crates/pqueue-projection/src/lib.rs). Define how declared numeric buckets report nulls (the no-activity bucket) — e.g. a declared null bucket computed as a base-filter count minus indexed rows, or a null-sentinel key encoding. Pick one and specify it; fixture record act_004 (engagement_probability = null) exercises it.
2. Cursor ordering tie-break: define the ultimate tie-break for stable pagination when the declared sort fields tie (recommendation: the internal item id, implicitly appended to every ordering). Caller-visible sort fields must be fields of the declared index — note `action_id` is NOT a field of the canonical range index.
3. Declared numeric buckets: buckets are caller-declared, not fixed. The 1%-wide bucket ladder in superseded pqueue-630dbeaa was illustrative only. The canonical conformance fixture declares: exact 0 -> "0%", (0.08, 0.10] -> "8.01-10%", (0.10, 0.15] -> "10.01-15%", (0.45, 0.50] -> "45.01-50%", null -> "no-activity".
4. Side/projection records: define record semantics and the `side_record_query` capability flag, and state that implementation is deferred beyond this epic — all backends advertise it unavailable and return the structured unsupported error.
bead.acceptance:
1. `rg -n 'api-hot-projection-query-surface|hot projection|range scan|side-record query|cursor pagination|bounded mutation|claim by query' docs` finds the new governing contract.
2. `rg -n 'Snorri-specific|Niflheim|ClickHouse|arbitrary SQL|RESP' docs/helix/02-design docs/helix/03-test` finds explicit non-goals or deferrals.
3. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
